mechanism_narrative: The current federal funds rate of 4.0% compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of instances when FEDFUNDS is at 4.0% (t-test p>0.05 for positive returns).

mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate above 4.5% signals monetary tightening, increasing discount rates and compressing equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when FEDFUNDS > 4.5 (t-test p>0.05 for negative returns).

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) and CPIAUCSL signal monetary tightening with rising inflation, increasing risk premia and causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS change > 0.1pp and CPIAUCSL change > 0.2% in the last month
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when FEDFUNDS increases by >0.1pp and CPIAUCSL increases by >0.2% in the last month (t-test p>0.05 for negative returns).

mechanism_narrative: When unemployment rate (UNRATE) exceeds 5.0% and employment (PAYEMS) falls below 135,000,000, it signals a deteriorating labor market and weak economic growth, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
regime_hint: high unemployment and weak labor market
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when UNRATE > 5.0 and PAYEMS < 135000 (t-test p>0.05 for negative returns).

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts (HOUST) below 2000 thousand units signal weak residential construction and declining consumer demand, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when HOUST < 2000 (t-test p>0.05 for negative returns).

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production (INDPRO) above 110.0 indicates strong manufacturing activity and economic expansion, supporting positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 50% of instances when INDPRO > 110.0 (t-test p>0.05 for positive returns).

mechanism_narrative: The current real GDP level (GDPC1) at 11206.1 billion dollars supports corporate earnings growth, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 50% of instances when GDPC1 is at 11206.1 (t-test p>0.05 for positive returns).

mechanism_narrative: An unemployment rate above 5.0% signals a weak labor market and potential economic slowdown, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when UNRATE > 5.0 (t-test p>0.05 for negative returns).
